text: Antonella Ragno-Lonzi, born on 6 June 1940, is an Italian fencer and Olympic champion in the foil event. She won a gold medal in foil at the 1972 Summer Olympics in Munich and earned bronze medals at the 1960 and 1964 Summer Olympics. She is married to Gianni Lonzi, who won Italy's gold medal in the men's water polo event at the 1960 Summer Olympics.
